coverage.scope: Every retained service cell, managed component execution, named diagnostic/proposal and excluded screen in the dec7a734 public result records. Per-request samples are not trials. No completeness claim for unarchived private runs or logs.

metric_definitions.cell_rtf: Unweighted mean of per-request RTFs; terminal completion is separate.
metric_definitions.group_rtf: Mean/min/max/sample stdev of the recorded cell means; per-repetition values retained.
metric_definitions.repetition_scope: Two tuning repetitions in one server; not fresh-server uncertainty.
metric_definitions.quality: WER, embedding-cosine SIM and UTMOS; WavLM speaker verification is separately labelled. Descriptive, not non-inferiority.

results/service-development.json.scope: Host-driven exploratory service screens, not managed Harness service qualification; only the separate S3 component was Harness-managed.
results/service-development.json.protocol: Same canonical Seed-TTS EN tuning requests; 2*C disjoint warmups; two consecutive 64-request repetitions at each concurrency in one server lifetime. Not the frozen five-fresh-server evaluation protocol. Both repetitions reuse canonical seed_index=0; stochastic execution need not produce byte-identical audio.
results/service-development.json.hardware: One allocated NVIDIA L20X per server; hardware_group distinguishes physical cards without publishing identifiers.
results/service-development.json.comparison_limit: Only engine/clean-k8/s3-k8 share device-A. Speaker/unpadded share device-B, with no matching independent-engine cell on that device in this archive; no cross-device speedup claim.

results/service-followup-development.jso.scope: Host-driven development only; not managed Harness service qualification.
results/service-followup-development.jso.protocol: 64 canonical tuning requests, two consecutive repetitions per concurrency in one server lifetime, seed_index=0 in both; 2*C disjoint warmups.
limitations: Device-B has no paired engine measurement.
SIM uses mean WavLM embedding cosine, not the independent engine WavLM-large speaker-verification metric.
No final fresh-server repetitions or disjoint evaluation split completed.
New batch-setup and active-onset prototypes remain local; no service gain is claimed for the submitted S3-only change.

The pinned speaker-verification source and checkpoint hashes match the standalone engine, but this recorded environment does not claim its full locked evaluator identity.

results/replica4-interrupted.json.reason: GPU allocator reclaimed the allocation for a scheduled CI booking. Parent process exited 143. The final C32 cell has 61 failed requests and must be excluded from performance claims.

results/hift-service-precision-diagnosti.scope: HiFT diagnostic with service-matched precision; no candidate service treatment
results/hift-service-precision-diagnosti.reason: The original microbenchmark forced cuDNN TF32 off, whereas the service already enables it. A matched-precision diagnostic found identical waveforms and no improvement. Treatment was pruned before launch.
limitations: The two C32 controls were slower than prior allocations; no cross-allocation gain or causal explanation is claimed.
Two reused tuning repetitions are not held-out final qualification.
